description: This file defines the PHP class PcaConnectorAdClient, which extends the AwsClient class. It serves as a client for interacting with the PcaConnectorAd service in AWS, providing method signatures for various operations such as creating, deleting, getting, listing, and updating resources related to the service. The class includes method annotations indicating both synchronous and asynchronous methods for each operation.
